## Albino Cave Spider (CR 1/2)

**XP** 200  
 N Tiny vermin  
 **Init** +4; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft.; Perception +4  
 

**Defense**

 
 **AC** 17, touch 16, flat-footed 13 (+4 Dex, +1 natural, +2 size)  
 **hp** 8 (1d8)  
 **Fort** +2; **Ref** +4; **Will** +0  
 **Immune** vermin traits  
 

**Offense**

 
 **Speed** 20 ft., climb 10 ft  
 **Melee** bite +6 (1d3+4 plus poison)  
 **Space** 2 1/2 ft.; **Reach** 2 1/2 ft.  
 

**Statistics**

 
 **Str** 4, **Dex** 18, **Con** 10, Int—, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 3  
 **Base Atk** +0; **CMB** +9; **CMD** 9  
 **Feats** Weapon Finesse  
*House rules: Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
 **Skills** Acrobatics +4 (+12 jump), Climb +12, Stealth +16; **Racial Modifiers** +8 to Acrobatics when jumping, +4 Perception, +4 Stealth; use Dex to modify Climb  
 

**Special Abilities**

 
 **Poison (Ex)** Bite—injury; *save* Fort DC 14; *frequency* 1/round for 4 rounds; *effect* 1d2 Constitution damage; *cure* 1 save.
